measured_task.name: place_on_cell
measured_task.instruction: Place the supply piece on the highlighted cell without moving other pieces.
measured_task.bench_note: Oct 25 12:4x (after the paper was reset): grid re-measured by the calibrated camera (36.3 mm cells, centre 0.1695/-0.0169). Robot pieces = white plastic bottle caps (~33 mm, ~17 mm tall); supply line on the robot's right, located by gemini-4-argon at x 0.127/0.175/0.221, y -0.125. Humans play coins.

bench_profile.notes: Round upright caps only; locked calibrated roll. Requires fresh traces and training; not a policy certification.
